args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status: healthy, error rate 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to promotion — worth investigating how it reached production.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back and healthy again, and the SEV2 incident is open.

- **What was wrong:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** I rolled all three regions back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. A follow-up check shows the service healthy in every region, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api), which paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the current health.

This needs a follow-up: the test version of v2.3.1 was already unhealthy in staging before it went to production. I noted this in the incident so someone can look into how it got through.
